title: Age-standardized prevalence of current tobacco use among persons aged 15 years and older
graph_title: Percentage of persons aged 15-49 who use tobacco
national_indicator_available: Percentage of persons aged 15-49 who use tobacco
national_indicator_description: This indicator measures the percentage of persons aged 15-49 who use any tobacco product, including smoked (cigarettes, kreteks, pipes, cigars, cheroots, cigarillos, and water pipes) and smokeless (snuff by mouth, snuff by nose, chewing tobacco, and betel quid with tobacco) tobacco products.
computation_definitions: The indicator is defined as the percentage of the population aged 15-49 who currently use any tobacco product (smoked and/or smokeless tobacco) on a daily or non-daily basis.
computation_calculations: Number of current tabacco users aged 15-49 years / Total population aged 15-49 years * 100
other_info: Figures on tobacco use in the Demographic and Health Survey are given separately for men and women; for the purposes of this dashboard, overall figures are calculated as a simple arithmetic mean of the figures for men and women.
comments_limitations: For comparability, this dashboard uses data for men and women aged 15-49. Data for men aged 15-59 are also available for certain years from the same source, but are not used here. It is worth noting that tobacco usage is generally higher in older age groups, so these figures may slightly underestimate usage in the overall population aged 15 years and older.
indicator_definition: A measure of the number of people who are current tobacco smokers in relation to all persons aged 15 years and older.
un_custodian_agency: World Health Organization (WHO), Framework Convention on Tobacco Control (FCTC)

source_other_info_1: Figures on tobacco use are available beginning in 2010.
